title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 527  An Act Converting the Lutucan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Sariaya, Province of Quezon, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Lutucan National High School, and Appropriating Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Lutucan Barangay tại Thị trấn Sariaya, Tỉnh Quezon thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Lutucan Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lutucan Barangay ในเทศบาล Sariaya จังหวัด Quezon เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lutucan แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Lutucan Barangay di Kotamadya Sariaya, Provinsi Quezon menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lutucan Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Lutucan Barangay di Perbandaran Sariaya, Wilayah Quezon kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lutucan Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Lutucan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Sariaya, Province of Quezon, is
converted into a national high school to be known as the Lutucan National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
